script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t0, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(k.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', k.job_status, 'correlation_id', k.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', k.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', k.progress_message, 'error_code', k.error_code, 'error_message', k.error_message) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job k
         WHERE k.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND k.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.key}}' AND k.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS key_job,
       CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS to_db_id, t.to_id AS to_no, t.gr_no, t.organization_id, CAST(t.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,
       (SELECT p.step_name FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'PWC|{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.toId}}' AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_lock,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(o.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', o.job_status, 'correlation_id', o.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', o.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', o.progress_message, 'error_code', o.error_code, 'error_message', o.error_message)) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job o
         WHERE o.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.command = 'COMPLETE_PUTAWAY' AND o.correlation_id = 'TO|{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.toId}}' AND o.job_status IN ('QUEUED',
		'VALIDATING', 'READY_TO_COMMIT', 'COMMITTING_PUTAWAY', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')) AS open_jobs,
       (SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(x.id AS CHAR), 'job_status', x.job_status, 'correlation_id', x.correlation_id, 'progress_percent', x.progress_percent,
		'progress_message', x.progress_message, 'error_code', x.error_code, 'error_message', x.error_message) AS CHAR) FROM gd_async_job x
         WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND x.command = 'COMPLETE_PUTAWAY' AND x.correlation_id = 'TO|{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.toId}}' ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_job
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t0) n
  LEFT JOIN transfer_order_putaway t
    ON t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND t.id = {{node:code_node_PSguard.data.toId}}
   AND t.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', h.`id`, 'to_status', h.`to_status`, 'plant_id', h.`plant_id`, 'to_id', h.`to_id`, 'movement_type', h.`movement_type`, 'ref_doc_type', h.`ref_doc_type`,
		'gr_no', h.`gr_no`, 'receiving_no', h.`receiving_no`, 'supplier_id', h.`supplier_id`, 'assigned_to', h.`assigned_to`, 'created_by', h.`created_by`, 'created_at',
		DATE_FORMAT(h.`created_at`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'), 'organization_id', h.`organization_id`, 'ref_doc', h.`ref_doc`, 'remarks', h.`remarks`, 'create_user', h.`create_user`,
		'create_dept', h.`create_dept`, 'create_time', SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(h.`create_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23), 'update_user', h.`update_user`, 'update_time',
		SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(h.`update_time`, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23), 'is_deleted', h.`is_deleted`, 'tenant_id', h.`tenant_id`, 'quality_insp_no', h.`quality_insp_no`,
		'qi_id', h.`qi_id`, 'sub_tenant_id', h.`sub_tenant_id`, 'to_id_sn', h.`to_id_sn`, 'to_id_type', h.`to_id_type`, 'previous_status', h.`previous_status`, 'is_processing',
		h.`is_processing`, 'project_id', h.`project_id`) AS j,
       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, h.update_time, CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00')) AS lock_age_sec,
       (SELECT g.gr_status FROM goods_receiving g
         WHERE g.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND g.id = CAST(h.gr_no AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS gr_status
  FROM transfer_order_putaway h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_PSentry.data.toId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', l.`id`, 'line_index', l.`line_index`, 'item_code', l.`item_code`, 'item_name', l.`item_name`, 'item_desc', l.`item_desc`, 'batch_no', l.`batch_no`,
		'source_inv_category', l.`source_inv_category`, 'received_qty', l.`received_qty`, 'item_uom', l.`item_uom`, 'source_bin', l.`source_bin`, 'qty_to_putaway', l.`qty_to_putaway`,
		'pending_process_qty', l.`pending_process_qty`, 'putaway_qty', l.`putaway_qty`, 'target_location', l.`target_location`, 'remark', l.`remark`, 'button_split_d_mchzv',
		l.`button_split_d_mchzv`, 'line_status', l.`line_status`, 'is_split', l.`is_split`, 'parent_or_child', l.`parent_or_child`, 'parent_index', l.`parent_index`, 'unit_price',
		l.`unit_price`, 'total_price', l.`total_price`, 'po_no', l.`po_no`, 'qi_no', l.`qi_no`, 'target_inv_category', l.`target_inv_category`, 'serial_numbers', l.`serial_numbers`,
		'is_serialized_item', l.`is_serialized_item`, 'select_serial_number', l.`select_serial_number`, 'select_serial_numbers_d_prsys', l.`select_serial_numbers_d_prsys`,
		'storage_location', l.`storage_location`, 'hu_data', l.`hu_data`, 'gr_line_id', l.`gr_line_id`, 'handling_unit_id', l.`handling_unit_id`, 'project_id', l.`project_id`,
		'parent_id', l.`parent_id`, 'item_bundle_id', l.`item_bundle_id`) AS j
  FROM transfer_order_putaway_jz8m9w3h_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.transfer_order_putaway_id = {{node:code_node_PSentry.data.toId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY l.id

SELECT JSON_MERGE_PRESERVE(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(i.`id` AS CHAR), 'based_uom', CAST(i.`based_uom` AS CHAR), 'item_batch_management', i.`item_batch_management`, 'material_costing_method',
		i.`material_costing_method`, 'serial_number_management', i.`serial_number_management`, 'stock_control', i.`stock_control`, 'material_code', i.`material_code`),
		JSON_OBJECT('table_uom_conversion', COALESCE(
         (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('alt_uom_id', CAST(u.`alt_uom_id` AS CHAR), 'base_qty', u.`base_qty`)) OVER (ORDER BY u.id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
            FROM item_mji552rc_sub u WHERE u.Item_id = i.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1), JSON_ARRAY()))) AS j
  FROM item i
 WHERE i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND i.is_deleted = 0
   AND i.id IN (SELECT l.item_code FROM transfer_order_putaway_jz8m9w3h_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.transfer_order_putaway_id = {{node:code_node_PSentry.data.toId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.item_code IS NOT NULL)
 ORDER BY i.id

script.code:
SELECT JSON_OBJECT('material_id', CAST(k.m AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(k.b AS CHAR), 'method', i.material_costing_method,
         'fifo', COALESCE(f.n, 0), 'wa', COALESCE(w.n, 0)) AS j
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l.item_code AS m, COALESCE(l.batch_no, 0) AS b FROM transfer_order_putaway_jz8m9w3h_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.transfer_order_putaway_id = {{node:code_node_PSentry.data.toId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.item_code IS NOT NULL) k
  JOIN item i ON i.id = k.m AND i.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND i.is_deleted = 0 AND i.stock_control <> 0
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT f.material_id AS m, COALESCE(f.batch_id, 0) AS b, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fifo_costing_history f
     WHERE f.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.plant_id = (SELECT h.plant_id FROM transfer_order_putaway h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_PSentry.data.toId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0) AND f.organization_id = (SELECT h.organization_id FROM transfer_order_putaway h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_PSentry.data.toId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0)
       AND f.material_id IN (SELECT l.item_code FROM transfer_order_putaway_jz8m9w3h_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.transfer_order_putaway_id = {{node:code_node_PSentry.data.toId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.item_code IS NOT NULL)
     GROUP BY f.material_id, COALESCE(f.batch_id, 0)) f ON f.m = k.m AND f.b = k.b
  LEFT JOIN (SELECT w.material_id AS m, COALESCE(w.batch_id, 0) AS b, COUNT(*) AS n FROM wa_costing_method w
     WHERE w.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.plant_id = (SELECT h.plant_id FROM transfer_order_putaway h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_PSentry.data.toId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0) AND w.organization_id = (SELECT h.organization_id FROM transfer_order_putaway h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_PSentry.data.toId}} AND h.is_deleted = 0)
       AND w.material_id IN (SELECT l.item_code FROM transfer_order_putaway_jz8m9w3h_sub l WHERE l.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSentry.data.tenantId}}' AND l.transfer_order_putaway_id = {{node:code_node_PSentry.data.toId}} AND l.is_deleted = 0 AND l.item_code IS NOT NULL)
     GROUP BY w.material_id, COALESCE(w.batch_id, 0)) w ON w.m = k.m AND w.b = k.b
 WHERE (COALESCE(f.n, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(w.n, 0) > 0)
    OR (i.material_costing_method = 'First In First Out' AND COALESCE(f.n, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(w.n, 0) > 0)
    OR (i.material_costing_method = 'Weighted Average' AND COALESCE(w.n, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(f.n, 0) > 0)
 ORDER BY k.m, k.b

script.code:
SELECT CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS job_id, j.job_status, t.is_processing,
       SUBSTRING(DATE_FORMAT(t.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s.%f'), 1, 23) AS update_time,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = CONCAT('PWC|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4)) AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref
  FROM gd_async_job j
  LEFT JOIN transfer_order_putaway t ON t.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND t.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AND t.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_PSguard.data.key}}' AND j.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 1
